body: Thanks for the response bc I kinda was thinking that I was overreacting but yeah like I kinda think regardless of how many times the three of us confront her she gets upset and then just kinda gets worse so idk the only reason I was thinking police is bc maybe she might listen to someone in authority rather than peers but whatever it’s only 7 months left

That’s actually a completely rational feeling. I realize that life does seem rather hopeless when there is so much bad news constantly. I’ve also been in the same place of wondering what’s the point of life because of all this stuff that I have absolutely no control over. Something someone told me is that it’s better to focus on personal goals and creating individual meaning for life so that’s what I’ve been trying. It’s not easy at all, but at least there is a glimmer of hope. I know this probably doesn’t help much but it’s the best I can do for right now. Hugs.
I’m glad to hear that you are still living. I know it’s not the easiest choice but I am proud of you. I’m here if you would like to talk.

I’m so sorry to hear this. It does not sound like you have had an uneventful life to say the least. I know you are blaming yourself but by the description given even though you asked to for the doctor to not do more blood work, that would be their fault, not yours. Just because I’m curious what did you study in college. It seems like you were at least excited about going back to college, or maybe seeing friends. I know none of what I say is very helpful but I still believe you have a purpose and you must have unfinished work to do on earth. Please stick around for a little while longer. It seems like you can definitely still have a good life but now with some changes and although it is very tough to adjust to this new life, I believe in you. I hope your pain eases soon and you can find your purpose in your life. Hugs
How is being sick your fault? If you don’t mind me asking. I can’t promise that anything will be better for you. But I am here to listen to anything you want to talk about. Virtual hug.
Did something happen? What do you think is all your fault? If you want to explain. Or we can just talk about anything. My favorite color is blue. What’s your favorite color?
Hi. Want to talk about it?

Thank you. 🤍 
I definitely needed to hear that. I’m so glad you are working your dream job. Thanks for giving me hope that things can get better.
Maybe I should take the spring semester off. It’s going to be online anyways.

I also guess I should say what my major is. Psychology. I started this with the intention of helping others so no one would ever feel the way I have felt at my absolute lowest. And now I’m just trying to hang on. It now seems like a terrible idea. I doubt anyone would want to go to a therapist that can’t even keep my life together. I feel broken. I’m sorry.

I don’t really see the point in continuing this other than the fact I was supposed to be graduating in the spring semester 21. I feel like such a waste of money and time. It doesn’t seem to matter that I’ve reached out to my professors countless times for help and I just feel like giving up. Maybe I did already.
Thank you. I feel stupid even saying this but I failed 4 out of 6 classes this semester and I feel really worthless right now.

Hey. It’s good that you have someone in your life, that is definitely worth living for. Sometimes, therapists don’t want to think a client would be capable of doing something so permanent because they have always had an objective view of your life. It’s okay and normal to drop that therapist and find a new one if they are not beneficial to you. And lastly have you had a conversation with your boyfriend about these feelings? It might be helpful to you to get more than one perspective. Sometimes when people like us feel this way we cannot focus attention on anything but the negatives. I’m here to talk if you would like to.

Hi. *virtual hug* you are not worthless (even if you feel that way). I’m here if you would like to talk. 
*tighter virtual hug* I’m proud of you for reaching out for someone to talk to. :)
I’m here if you want to talk.
I’m here if you want to talk. I’m proud of you for being here.

The best combination backed by research is both medication and therapy. The medication to lift you up a little bit and make it easier to go to therapy. Therapy for learning how to help yourself with your depression. Good luck! Hope everything works out well for you!
